hack.category: DEX / AMM (Pangolin Hedera, HeliSwap — network-level exploit)
hack.root_cause: Smart Contract Service (HTS) Code Bug — Uniswap V2 Port Exploit
hack.description: A bug in Hedera's Smart Contract Service — specifically in Uniswap V2 code ported to Hedera Token Service — allowed an attacker to drain LP positions across multiple DEXs, triggering a chain-wide shutdown and $12M ecosystem TVL exodus from just ~$515K actually stolen.
